roadmap.title: First visit to the building
roadmap.description: Hang up on the stalker's calls, then build the pistol.

roadmap.title: Tape 1: Virginia
roadmap.description: Play Tape 1 in the supermarket, then finish it with the Mirror Shard.

roadmap.title: Second visit
roadmap.description: Pet Tonia, get the gas mask, and take the pills and Virginia's record.

roadmap.title: Tape 2: Allen
roadmap.description: Shoot a crow and the Shade, collect the lighthouse pills, and finish Tape 2.

roadmap.title: Third visit
roadmap.description: Get the shotgun with the flare gun.

roadmap.title: Tape 3: Max
roadmap.description: Ride and trick the Bull, open the Mayer Lab, collect the factory pills, and finish Tape 3.

roadmap.title: Tape 4: Lucas
roadmap.description: Collect the fragments, Rosemary's record and the forest pills, stun the Flash, and finish Tape 4.

roadmap.title: Rainbow Tape and ending
roadmap.description: High five Dave, finish Tape 5, then clean up building pills and records and finish the game.

achievements.description: Finish Tape 1
achievements.summary: Finish Tape 1, Virginia's tape.

steps.text: Play the tape in the office, then use the @item{Mirror Shard} to make @npc{Virginia} fly into the mirrors until you reach the dollhouse party.

achievements.description: Finish Tape 2
achievements.summary: Finish Tape 2, Allen's tape.

steps.text: Take the tape from Allen's house and play it in the office.
Get the @item{Flare Gun} from the ship below the lighthouse, go through the warehouse, and put the bulb back in the lighthouse.

achievements.description: Finish Tape 3
achievements.summary: Finish Tape 3, Max's tape.

steps.text: Take the tape from Max's apartment, play it in the office, and play through the factory level to its end.

achievements.description: Finish Tape 4
achievements.summary: Finish Tape 4, Lucas's tape.

guide.context: The bunker code is different each time you play Tape 4.

steps.text: Take the tape from Lucas's apartment and play it in the office.

Go to the bunker entrance. Its code comes from four towers: by the water plant, by the gondola route, at the church steeple, and behind the crypt. At each tower, point the radio at the bright stars. Each star shows a number from 0 to 9.
Enter the code at the bunker, open the bunker room doors, then use the large weapon in the Radar Tower to defeat @enemy{The Flash}.

achievements.description: Finish Tape 5.
achievements.summary: Finish Tape 5, the Rainbow Tape.

steps.text: Find the open large container by the building's front entrance on floor 1, take the tape inside, and play it in the office.
Play each tape you find to unlock the next platforming section, and fight through to the end.

achievements.description: Finish the game.
achievements.summary: Finish the game.

steps.text: Finish the Rainbow Tape, then play through the last visit to the building to the ending.

achievements.description: Collect all pills in your building
achievements.summary: Collect all 24 pills in your building.

guide.context: The pills are spread over five visits. After Tape 4 the basement floods. If you missed basement pills, break the two large crates on your right in the water by shooting a flare over them. Shoot the glowing barrels and throw pills into the toxic puddles, then toss one more pill across the fence so it lands in the puddle behind it. That drains the water.

achievements.description: Collect all vinyl records
achievements.summary: Collect all 6 vinyl records.

guide.context: Put each record on the office turntable. Five are in your building and one is in Tape 4.

collectibles.name: Virginia's record
collectibles.method: After Tape 1, cut the yellow tape with the @item{Mirror Shard}, look at the broken mirror to reveal a key, open the bathroom door behind it, and take the record from the sink.

collectibles.name: Allen's record
collectibles.method: After Tape 2, fire a flare at the darkness over the attic stairs, cross the attic, and shoot a flare down through the hole in the floor. Back downstairs, use the door on the left in the back area and fire another flare through the gap in the wall. Go into the new area, through the door straight ahead, shoot the last darkness, and take the record from the bed.

collectibles.name: Max's record
collectibles.method: After Tape 3, throw a lure pill into the truck's engine, drive through the wall into the daughter's room, and take the record from the desk. Reverse the truck to get out.

collectibles.name: Lucas's record
collectibles.method: After Tape 4, use the radio on the devices in the back room, starting near the front door, to open the sealed chest. Some need an odd angle, such as from inside the fireplace or from boxes.

collectibles.name: Rosemary's record
collectibles.method: Fire a flare at the graveyard darkness, then aim the radio at the record by the grave with glasses on it.

collectibles.name: Desmond's record
collectibles.method: After the Rainbow Tape, @npc{Tonia} gives you the bedroom key. Fire one flare to clear the darkness and take the record from the back cabinet.

achievements.description: Pet Tonia
achievements.summary: Pet @npc{Tonia}, the white cat.

steps.text: After finishing Tape 1, go to the office when @npc{Tonia} is there and pet her.

achievements.description: Hang up on your sneaky stalker
achievements.summary: Hang up on the stalker's phone call.

steps.text: When the phone rings, pick it up and hang up before the caller finishes, for example by walking away.
The phone rings several times in the story, so you can try again.

achievements.description: Acquire the Pistol in your building
achievements.summary: Build the @item{Pistol} in your building.

steps.text: Take the pistol slide from the top of the vending machine in the 2nd-floor hallway.
The pistol barrel is taped beneath the Maintenance Room's table; grab it.
In the basement laundry room, take the fuse from one washing machine and put it in the washing machine next to it. When the machine moves, take the grip from the wall behind it.
Use the three parts on the workbench in the basement.

achievements.description: Acquire the Gas Mask in your building
achievements.summary: Pick up the @item{Gas Mask} in your building.

steps.text: After Tape 1, go to the basement and cut the yellow tape next to the elevator with the @item{Mirror Shard}.
Break the planks over the vent, crawl through it, and take the mask from the table.

achievements.description: Acquire the Shotgun in your building
achievements.summary: Pick up the @item{Shotgun} in your building.

steps.text: After Tape 2, go to the vent near Max's door on floor 1. Fire a @item{Flare Gun} shot at the darkness, then shoot the board holding the shotgun so it falls.
Go to the basement vent room, shoot the darkness there, and pick up the shotgun.

achievements.description: Push a cart into the water on the way to Homa Mart
achievements.summary: Knock a shopping cart into the water while heading to @loc{Homa-Mart}.

steps.text: Walk to the store and push one of the shopping carts you find until it falls into the water.

achievements.description: Give a mannequin a face
achievements.summary: Put a sticky note on a mannequin's face.

guide.context: If the note is not on the office desk, check the table in the CCTV room.

steps.text: After you turn off the power in the offices, take the sticky note from the desk.
Go back to the shop floor and stick it on the standing mannequin's face.

achievements.description: Scare The Watcher away using the Mirror Shard
achievements.summary: Scare away @enemy{The Watcher} with the @item{Mirror Shard}.

steps.text: Get the Watcher's attention so it charges you.
Turn around and hold up the shard just before it reaches you so it sees its own reflection.

achievements.description: Shoot a crow
achievements.summary: Shoot a crow.

guide.context: If you miss, reload the last auto-save to try again. A pistol ammo box is in the rowboat on the beach to the left of the start.

steps.text: Equip the @item{Pistol}. Early in Tape 2, take the lighthouse bulb from the shack on the beach.
Climb the rock slope that goes up to the right. Three crows sit on the fence above; shoot one before they fly off.

achievements.description: Damage The Shade using a weapon
achievements.summary: Damage @enemy{The Shade} with a weapon.

steps.text: When the Shade comes at you in the parking lot, shoot the man-shaped figure in the middle of the black mass.

achievements.description: Shoot down a Shade projectile
achievements.summary: Shoot a falling object thrown by @enemy{The Shade}.

steps.text: After you open the electric gate and climb down the cliff, the Shade throws crates. Look up and shoot one while it is in the air.

achievements.description: Ride The Bull for 5 seconds
achievements.summary: Stay on top of @enemy{The Bull} for 5 seconds.

guide.context: This only works while the Bull is there. If you missed it, replay Tape 3.

steps.text: In the tunnel, run past the Bull to the end and climb up on the rocks.
When it comes at you, jump onto its back and hold on for at least 5 seconds.

achievements.description: Open the Mayer Lab.
achievements.summary: Open the Mayer Lab.

guide.context: Use the Mirror Shard to find the sockets. You get the chips as you play through the factory.

steps.text: On the factory's 3rd floor, take the keycard from the Archives room.
Put the 3V chip in the socket farthest from the lab, the 2V chip in the socket behind the fence to the side, and the 1V chip in the socket next to the lab door.
Use the keycard on the reader at the lab door.

achievements.description: Trick The Bull into attacking an inkblot
achievements.summary: Lure @enemy{The Bull} into hitting an inkblot.

steps.text: After you make the lure pills, go to the train tracks toward the quarry, where inkblots attack you. Do not kill them.
Throw a lure pill near the inkblots so the Bull charges.
Keep the inkblots in that spot until the Bull hits one.

achievements.description: Find and listen to all of Lucas' session fragments
achievements.summary: Find and listen to all 10 of Lucas's session fragments.

guide.context: Hold the @item{Radio Device} while you walk. Spikes show on its display, and it turns green when you are near a fragment. At the camp tents, activate the red light on the radio to listen. The first five appear after the towers light up, and the last five appear after the Flash leaves the area near the bunker.

collectibles.method: East of the well. Use the radio near the camp tent.

collectibles.name: Session fragment 2

collectibles.method: Use the radio near the tent.

collectibles.name: Session fragment 9

collectibles.name: Session fragment 10
collectibles.location: Near the entrance to the church
collectibles.method: Use the radio near the tent.

achievements.description: Find Rosemary's secret song.
achievements.summary: Find Rosemary's hidden record.

steps.text: In Tape 4, after the church tower code, climb to the tower roof and shoot the darkness in the graveyard with the @item{Flare Gun}.
Go to the fresh grave with glasses on it, look with the @item{Mirror Shard}, and use the radio on the record to pick it up.

achievements.description: Stun The Flash using your Radio Device
achievements.summary: Stun @enemy{The Flash} with the @item{Radio Device}.

guide.context: The red lights are not always showing, so keep running until they appear.

steps.text: While the Flash chases you, point the radio at its three red lights and activate each one.

achievements.description: Give Dave a high five while fighting for your mind
achievements.summary: High five the mannequin Dave in the Rainbow Tape.

guide.context: If you miss it, reload the last checkpoint and try again.

steps.text: Inside the Rainbow Tape, after you finish overwriting Virginia's section, jump into the open shipping container full of mannequins.
Interact with the one holding out its hand as you jump toward it.

achievements.description: Find all weapons in the game
achievements.summary: Find all 7 weapons.

guide.context: You pick these up as you play; the radio is the last one.

collectibles.name: Flashlight
collectibles.method: Take it from the shelf.

collectibles.name: Pistol
collectibles.method: Build it from three parts at the basement workbench.

collectibles.name: Mirror Shard
collectibles.method: Take it as part of the story.

collectibles.name: Flare Gun
collectibles.method: Take it from the ship below the lighthouse.

collectibles.name: Shotgun
collectibles.method: Shoot down the board with the flare gun, then collect it in the basement.

collectibles.name: Lure Pills
collectibles.method: Make them as part of the story.

collectibles.name: Radio Device
collectibles.method: Take it from the ranger cabin at the start of Tape 4.

achievements.description: Find all pills in the game
achievements.estTime: covered by the area pill achievements
achievements.summary: Collect all 72 pills in the game.

guide.context: The count is 24 in the building and 12 in each of the four tapes.

steps.text: Collect every pill on the five lists: your building and Tapes 1 to 4.
